n: USB Rapid Charging Module for FT2 ELEC Series (FT2A-CHGR-USBA/C)
d: FT2A-CHGR-USBA/C USB Rapid Charging Module for FT2 ELEC Series, USB Type-C & Type-A High Power Charging Ports, Bus Powered

specs.label: USB-C
specs.value: Supplies 32.5 Watts at 5, 9, 15, or 20 Volts DC as demanded by the device under charge

specs.label: USB-A
specs.value: Supplies 12 Watts at 5 Volts DC if USB-C port is not in use; Supplies 2.5 Watts at 5 Volts DC if USB-C port is in use
